introduction: Longhollow is under siege while a protected temple, woodland campsite and witch's shrine offer separate routes. The mayor's five-proof delivery leads to a physical bracer for Solar. The witch's potion and poison experiments have independent intermediate hand-ins and distinct physical-output finales. Clothing services and scene lore remain separate.
orientation: Follow the forest path into the tall grass. The campsite beside the brook holds the trapper and traders; the stone shrine holds the witch. Trampled grass leads southeast to the ruined parish, its enemy leaders and Selune's temple.

Speak to the mayor in the clearing north of the parish. His proof set contains five distinct heads: the Bloodied Knight, necromancer, Fomorian chieftain, enchantress and dark priest. One head kind cannot replace another. The proof items are chance-loaded carried stock, not a reviewed personal-death achievement.

The knight and captive wife are upstairs in the mansion; the necromancer is at the burning stable and the dark priest chants in Market Square. The hidden briar route west of the grass leads through rock paths and a boulder entrance to the chieftain and enchantress in the caverns. Listed panels and doors reset open; no magical belt or glove gate is implemented here.

The mayor awards both the Longhollow bracer and an exquisite moonstone. Solar in Selune's inner sanctum accepts only the physical bracer for a star woven symbol, then disappears. Earlier mayor history is optional; a supplied bracer qualifies, while a moonstone or a spent-bracer receipt does not.

The witch narrates potion recipes in order, but each exact hand-in matches independently. Keep the distinct red, green and bubbling vials for the mist combination with the blood drop. The bubbling-vial recipe also rewards 25,000 copper through the supported native reward path; it charges no fee. Supplied exact outputs can feed the later recipe without producer history.

For the poison branch, two venom sacs plus mandrake produce a filled root; lotus, nightshade and red mushroom produce a filled head. Both prepared outputs plus the exact loose Kiss of Talona bloom complete the final blend. The nearby rooted vine is scenery, and the finished leaf's advertised poison behavior needs content review.

The trapper makes caps, boots, scarves, cloaks and a rare five-material headdress. Native boots cost 20 gold despite dialogue saying 15. Paid clothing is currently unavailable under active accounting. Four snake skins, two fox furs and two venom sacs exceed their respective ordinary cap-one supply; availability needs repair rather than a promise to wait for another reset.

Stock may be missing or carried by other players, and native NPCs may wander. Harv's shop remains implemented behind the alley panel despite his packing dialogue. Temple survivors, the captive wife, decorative corpses and Rolane's empty quest placeholder have no reviewed rescue, recovery or siege-ending completion.

Carry every offering directly, outside equipment or containers. Exact current supplies show readiness; an accounting-backed delivery records that hand-in once. Questions, optional producer receipts and printed promises do not confirm a personal kill, all-stage campaign, learned spell, title flag, rescue or applied item effect.

stories.title: Proof Against the Siege Leaders
stories.summary: Help the mayor identify those responsible for the siege by delivering five distinct enemy heads together. His exact reward is the Longhollow bracer and an exquisite moonstone. This receipt proves the hand-in, not personal kills, a rescued wife or a restored village. Supplied proofs qualify.

steps.hint: The Bloodied Knight in the mansion's upstairs chamber may carry this exact head. His squire and the nearby captive wife do not supply it. Shared stock can be absent even when the knight is present.
The necromancer at the burning stable may carry this exact head. His skeletal horses and zombie companion are separate creatures, not substitute proofs.
Follow the briar path and rocky route to the cavern complex. The chieftain in its deepest chamber may carry this exact head. Ordinary Fomorians and guards do not substitute.
The enchantress in the caverns' bedroom chamber may carry this exact head. The advisor and his maps provide scene guidance, not this proof.
The chanting dark priest in Market Square may carry this exact head. Temple priests, the captive wife and decorative corpses are not this offering.

steps.text: Deliver all five distinct heads to the mayor
steps.hint: Find the mayor in the clearing north of the village. Carry one of each exact head directly, outside containers or equipment, and offer them together. The reward is the bracer plus moonstone. The recorded delivery does not confirm killing the leaders yourself, rescuing the wife or ending the siege.

stories.title: Recognition by Selune's Solar
stories.summary: Bring the Longhollow bracer to Solar in the inner sanctum for the star woven symbol of Selune. The mayor's preceding delivery is optional preparation; the physical bracer is required. The moonstone is a different reward and is not accepted. Solar disappears after the exchange; spoken titles are not an additional title-system award.

steps.hint: The mayor exchanges the five distinct heads for a bracer and moonstone. This receipt explains one bracer source but cannot replace a bracer already spent or lost. A supplied bracer qualifies without this history.

steps.hint: Use the exact bracer awarded by the mayor, or a supplied copy. The exquisite moonstone is not a substitute, including one obtained in another zone. Keep the bracer directly carried for Solar's exchange.

steps.text: Offer the Longhollow bracer to Solar
steps.hint: Reach Selune's inner sanctum above the sanctuary. Solar may be absent from the current shared population and disappears after accepting the bracer. The star woven symbol is the actual item reward; no separate wife-rescue, personal-kill or title flag is required. Supplied bracers qualify.
